title: 验证与推理共享请求策略、SSRF 与 deadline
changes: Added one shared provider network policy resolver used by both buildGuardedModelFetch (inference) and provider validation.
The resolver produces a stable SHA-256 policyFingerprint over the normalized SSRF/private-network/origin/proxy inputs.
Validation now evaluates every probe target before sending: metadata, link-local, malformed URL, unsupported protocol and non-allowlisted hosts fail closed with blockedReason and stage=preflight.
One total 15s validation deadline is shared by the model listing and the fallback probe; all four probe families receive the same AbortSignal.
Validation results now carry policyFingerprint, stage, blockedReason and deadlineMs.
provider-transport-fetch no longer maintains its own SSRF policy assembly; it delegates to the shared resolver.
limitations: Validation applies the pre-flight host/IP decision and the shared fingerprint, then uses the Electron-owned transport (net.fetch / NetworkPool). DNS-level socket pinning remains in the runtime's fetchWithSsrFGuard.
The parity test compares the shared resolver's outputs and asserts the inference source imports it; it does not perform a live inference request.
No live third-party provider was contacted; no real-human evidence is claimed.
notChanged: No product lock, default value, or release status changed.
No paid provider request was made.

candidate.note: Tests and static checks ran on the clean parent tree; this evidence file is part of the same branch commit.
